items.text: Post-Sunday injuries watching: Lamar (ankle), Chase (conc)/Higgins (adductor), Barkley (ham)/Bigsby, Rice (ham)/Thornton (ankle), McConkey (foot agg), DJ Moore (shoulder), Bryant (ankle), Mariota (knee), others.
items.why: Comprehensive list of in-game exits and aggravations.
items.implication: Priority monitoring for Week 5 availability and handcuffs.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries and waiver stashes from absences.

items.text: Rashee Rice downgraded to doubtful with hamstring; left early after catch and did not return in Chiefs win.
items.implication: Likely misses or limited next; Chiefs WR room thinned further by Thornton.
items.opportunity: Xavier Worthy and remaining KC WRs see target bump; team interest in Tyreek Hill.

items.text: Lamar Jackson day-to-day with ankle injury; left stadium in protective boot after not returning vs Titans. Monitored/treated this week; hoped good spot.
items.why: Left ankle; Q to return mid-game then boot.
items.implication: Hold; Ravens offense changes significantly if sits. Henry volume may rise short-term.
items.opportunity: If out, elevated RB/TE usage in BAL.

items.text: Ja'Marr Chase ruled out with concussion after evaluation in first half vs Jaguars; walked off under own power then to locker room.
items.why: Concussion protocol after facemask/hit to head.
items.implication: Misses remainder; monitor protocol for Week 5. Tee Higgins had big game but later adductor issue.
items.opportunity: Increased targets to Higgins/other Bengals WRs while Chase out.

items.text: Saquon Barkley downgraded to out with hamstring injury early vs Rams after pulling up on run; seen walking normally post-game.
items.implication: Hold; IR if available. Eagles backfield to Bigsby/Shipley short-term.

items.text: Tyquan Thornton suffered dislocated ankle (put back by doctors), made plane, full eval + second opinion Monday; out indefinitely but good spirits. Career-best 111/2TD game.
items.implication: KC WR depth crisis with Rice also hurt; long-term absence.
items.opportunity: Elevated roles for Worthy/other KC pass-catchers; possible free agent addition.

items.text: DJ Moore aggravated shoulder injury in Bills loss; not considered a long-term issue as of right now.
items.why: Shoulder aggravation mid-game; did not return.
items.implication: Monitor practice; short-term risk but not season-ending.
items.opportunity: If limited/out, Keon Coleman/Shakir targets rise.

items.text: Ladd McConkey active for Chargers despite foot/rib issues (had LP-DNP-LP week).
items.why: Cleared after limited practices and prior cracked rib.
items.implication: Plays through; Levitan noted bigger dock still in projections.
items.opportunity: Full or near-full routes/targets if no further limit.
items.conflict: ETR bigger dock vs active status.

items.text: Eagles could be without four key players vs Rams: RT Lane Johnson (personal/Q), WR DeVonta Smith (ham), TE Dallas Goedert (knee), LB Zack Baun (conc). Situation worsening.
items.implication: Depleted offense; Hurts protection and targets impacted; Rams D boosted.
items.opportunity: Secondary PHI pass-catchers or opposing defense.

items.text: Small dock only on Puka Nacua (groin/hip); Rams do not intend to limit workload per Schefter. Expected to play and projected in strongly.
items.why: Aggregated reports overblown; Schefter/Glazer confirm no limit.

items.text: Tinier dock on Zay Flowers (hamstring); not expected to have hard pitch count per reporting. Expected to play.
items.implication: Viable start with minimal limitation risk.

items.text: Weekend reports summary: Expected Puka Nacua, Zay Flowers, Ladd McConkey, Tyjae Spears; GTD/optimistic Mike Evans; Not expected Jalen Coker, Terry McLaurin, Keenan Allen; Tyson Bagent starting.
items.implication: Clear start/sit signals for key WRs; Bagent stream option.
items.opportunity: Nacua/Flowers/McConkey volume; Evans GTD risk; McLaurin sit.

items.text: Mike Evans GTD/optimistic; Terry McLaurin not expected to play (along with Coker/Allen).
items.opportunity: If Evans out, TB WR depth; WAS WR2+ volume.

items.text: Chuba Hubbard is this year's Javonte Williams: boring mid-round RB no one wanted due to talent/role uncertainty who ends up starting and crushing.
items.why: Uncertain role/talent mid-round pick now producing as starter.
items.implication: ROS start/hold; strong mid-round value realization.
items.opportunity: Continued lead back snaps/carries in CAR.
